purpose: Teach: エクセル/シャンパン/猛暑/バスケ/棚田/日の出/レプリカ/特訓

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 家計簿、エクセルで管理始めたの。
lines.en: I started tracking our finances using Excel.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact opening. A small accomplishment shared like offering someone a cup of tea. Warm but not seeking praise. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね。誕生日に、シャンパンで乾杯しよう。
lines.en: That's great. We should toast with champagne on your birthday.
lines.style: Genuine delight in the idea. Soft, encouraging rhythm. The kind of suggestion offered like a small gift. Unhurried, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今年の夏、猛暑になりそう。
lines.en: The summer's going to be really intense this year.
lines.style: Observation spoken quietly, almost to herself. Slight breath before the thought lands. A note of concern underneath, but measured. Not catastrophizing — just noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちの弟、バスケに夢中。
lines.en: My younger brother's gotten really into basketball.
lines.style: Fondness breaking through in a quick shift in tempo. Genuine animation — she's thinking of him doing what he loves. Voice lifts on the second half.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今度、棚田の景色、見に行きたい。
lines.en: I really want to go see the rice terraces sometime.
lines.style: Soft longing underneath. The word "really" carries weight — this isn't casual. Quiet, like sharing something she's been imagining. Slow, almost dreamlike pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 山の上で、日の出、見られたら、感動するね。
lines.en: If we could catch the sunrise from the mountain, it'd be really moving.
lines.style: Invitation in the tone. Warm anticipation building. Eyes-wide openness about being moved by beauty. Gentle but present energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 博物館で、武将の鎧、レプリカ、触れるんだって。
lines.en: At the museum, you can actually touch the samurai armor replicas.
lines.style: Sparked curiosity. Quick, engaged delivery. Like she's just learned this and wants to share it immediately. Slight rise on the surprise of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏前に、ダイエット特訓、始めましょう。
lines.en: We should start our summer fitness plan before it gets too hot.
lines.style: Encouraging and playful without being pushy. A soft invitation to team up. Warm close — the suggestion lands like an inside joke between friends.
